title: Laguna Woods Village Taiwanese Club 南加州 拉古納伍茲台灣同鄉會
content_html: The Laguna Woods Village Taiwanese Club (拉古拿木屋台灣同鄉會) is a chapter of the Taiwanese Association of America (TAA, 全美台灣同鄉會), the national umbrella organization of Taiwanese American community associations. The chapter is listed under the TAA’s Western (美西) regional grouping and serves Taiwanese Americans residing in Laguna Woods Village, a senior community in Orange County, California.
